query:
DEFINE
    VAR _entity = TREATAS ( { "S" }, param_entity_view[entity_view_code] )
    VAR _fy     = TREATAS ( { 2025 }, param_fiscal_year[fiscal_year] )
    VAR _month  = TREATAS ( { 12 }, param_period[month_number] )
    VAR _tv     = TREATAS ( { "FY" }, param_time_view[time_view_code] )
    VAR _base   = TREATAS ( { "A" }, param_base_version[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_a  = TREATAS ( { "B" }, param_compare_a[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_b  = TREATAS ( { "PY" }, param_compare_b[choice_code] )
    VAR _ccy    = TREATAS ( { "USD" }, param_reporting_currency[currency_code] )
    VAR _fx     = TREATAS ( { "ACT" }, param_fx_basis[fx_basis_code] )
    VAR _units  = TREATAS ( { "M" }, param_units[units_code] )
    VAR _steps =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            FILTER (
                SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                    dim_bridge_step[step_code]
                    ,dim_bridge_step[step_label]
                    ,dim_bridge_step[step_sort]
                    ,_entity, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units
                    ,"@delta", CONVERT ( [Bridge Step Delta], DOUBLE )
                    ,"@is_total", CONVERT ( [Bridge Is Total], DOUBLE )
                )
                ,NOT ISBLANK ( [@is_total] )
            )
            ,"step_code", dim_bridge_step[step_code]
            ,"step_label", dim_bridge_step[step_label]
            ,"step_sort", dim_bridge_step[step_sort]
            ,"@delta", [@delta]
            ,"@is_total", [@is_total]
        )
    VAR _end =
        ROW (
            "step_code", "END"
            ,"step_label", "Actual NR"
            ,"step_sort", 999
            ,"@delta", CONVERT ( CALCULATE ( [Prof Net Revenue], _entity, _fy, _month, _tv, _base, _cmp_a, _cmp_b, _ccy, _fx, _units ), DOUBLE )
            ,"@is_total", 2
        )
EVALUATE
UNION ( _steps, _end )
ORDER BY [step_sort]
